noise: Independent Gaussian continuous X and y; D independent Bernoulli; lagged outcomes reconstructed normally.
linear: M1 stationary Gaussian AR(0.98); y[t] = mean(M1[t-62:t+1]) + Gaussian noise std 0.1; endpoints before 62 missing.
nonlinear: M1 and E1 independent IID Gaussian; y[t] = M1[t] + E1[t] + 2*M1[t]*E1[t-1] + Gaussian noise std 0.2; first endpoint missing. Marginal linear terms make both causal inputs discoverable by the frozen univariate selector, while the cross-lag interaction is outside flattened linear Ridge.

criteria.noise: Absolute equal-fold mean IC <= 0.10 for each of Ridge, GRU, TCN, C and D; no systematic nonlinear alpha in this fixed engineering panel. Not a significance claim or guarantee of zero individual folds.
criteria.linear: Ridge mean IC > 0.30; GRU and TCN each > 0.15 with all 11 folds finite. Neural models need not beat Ridge.
criteria.nonlinear: At least one of GRU/TCN exceeds Ridge equal-fold mean IC by > 0.05 with all 11 folds finite. This is a capacity check on the predeclared process, not model selection for market data.

failure_policy: Stop before freezing on any failed criterion. Do not tune architectures, seeds or generators in response.
test_mode: Only E2E/reproducibility software smoke tests may cap epochs at 2; real mode and calibration reject that budget.
